message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charges based on facts. The facts: Lin (林某甲) was a procurement management office specialist, used position to accept bribes (money) from bidders to help them win contracts, also gave insider info to a bidding agency for bribes. This is classic bribery (受贿). Also possibly abuse of power (滥用职权) because he used his position to influence procurement. The co-occurrence summary says 受贿 co-occurs with 滥用职权 (4 times). So likely both charges: 受贿 and 滥用职权. Also maybe "贪污" if he embezzled public funds? He didn't divert funds, he just accepted bribes. So not embezzlement. Not "职务侵占". So answer: 受贿;滥用职权.

Check if any other charges: maybe "行贿"? No, he is the recipient, not the giver. So only those two.

Thus final answer: [罪名]受贿;滥用职权<eoa>
